title: Photosynthesis (The Dr. Binocs Show)
summary: Dr. Binocs explains photosynthesis, the process plants use to make their own food. The word comes from Greek, with 'photo' meaning light and 'synthesis' meaning putting together. Plants take in carbon dioxide through tiny leaf openings called stomata and absorb water through their roots, and the chloroplasts in their leaves use sunlight to turn these into sugar for food and oxygen released into the air. The video ends with trivia: chlorophyll, the green pigment in chloroplasts, makes plants look green, and plants are called the lungs of the world because they produce the oxygen humans breathe.

topics.name: How photosynthesis works
topics.summary: Explains the meaning of the word photosynthesis and how plants use stomata, roots and chloroplasts to turn carbon dioxide, water and sunlight into sugar and oxygen.
